title: Staging security fixes verified locally; deployment remains blocked
summary: 246 distinct tests, both TypeScript projects, focused ESLint and isolated build passed. Added configuration matrix and continuation handoff. No deployment, hosted database action, paid API or live indexing.

changes.detail: Shared Supabase API-key headers and guarded IndexNow transport with offline regression tests.
Modern opaque keys no longer become Bearer tokens in direct runtime REST calls. IndexNow requires explicit consistent production identity, opt-in, key and canonical host.

Reject inherited staging outbound credentials, cron/manual worker configuration; block browser Auth messaging and Expo delivery outside production; remove implicit production owner-email authorization fallback; disable Git deployment in staging template.
Removed built-in IndexNow verification-key fallback and password-reset production URL fallback.
Admin IndexNow route reports disabled status; SEO REST verification helpers and synthetic test adapter use common key headers; hosting evidence includes additional integrations without values.
155-variable source configuration matrix, 150-call AST Supabase client inventory, exact staging variables, safe future branch strategy and explicit unresolved hosted/legacy-tooling blockers.

validation.name: Application and worker regressions
validation.detail: 167 application tests plus 71 worker tests; final 27-test focused run adds two IndexNow and six history tests, for 246 distinct passes. Synthetic fixtures and mocked provider/IndexNow transport only.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused ESLint
validation.detail: Root and learning app type checks with incremental writes disabled; focused lint passed on changed runtime/tooling/tests.

validation.name: Isolated production build
validation.detail: Initial public-font EACCES failure retained. Reviewed isolated retry passed at 2026-10-20T14:08:13.793Z; 15 changed runtime files match snapshot. Synthetic credentials, runtime fetch blocked, no deployment. Workspace tracing warning limits package claims.

validation.name: Hosted staging, production and browser acceptance
validation.detail: No hosted contact, migrations, deployments, paid inference, IndexNow submission, workers, crons or live UI preview. Production and deployment remain NO-GO.
